tagline: An AI-powered visual search and discovery platform for inspiration and commerce
hero_kpi_rationale: Monthly active users is the primary metric for platform growth and health, as it directly reflects adoption of the visual experience and user engagement, which are key drivers of advertising monetization.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from advertising on the platform.
kpis.description: Revenue increased by 16% in 2025, driven by improved monetization and an expanding user base.

kpis.name: Monthly Active Users
kpis.explanation: Number of users who used Pinterest at least once during the month.
kpis.description: 619 million monthly active users in 2025, up 12%, supported by AI improvements in recommendation relevance.

kpis.name: Average Revenue Per User
kpis.explanation: How much the company earns on average per active user.
kpis.description: Global ARPU increased by 4% in 2025, with strong growth in Europe (21%) and the rest of the world (40%).

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin improved from 4.4% in 2024 to 7.58% in 2025, due to revenue growth outpacing costs (operating income of $319.9M on $4,221.8M in revenue).

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash remaining after operating expenses and capital expenditures.
kpis.description: FCF reached $1,251.9 million in 2025, supported by strong revenue growth and cost discipline.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: 5,265 employees in 2025, indicating controlled personnel cost management despite revenue growth.

kpis.name: Average Revenue Per User in Europe
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated per active user in Europe.
kpis.description: ARPU in Europe surged by 21% in 2025, indicating stronger advertising penetration in a mature market.

kpis.name: Average Revenue Per User (Rest of World)
kpis.explanation: Revenue per user in emerging regions.
kpis.description: Rest of World ARPU increased by 40%, reflecting enhanced monetization in high-growth-potential regions.

risks.title: Loss of advertisers
risks.score_rationale: The company generates the majority of its revenue from advertising, and the loss of advertisers or a reduction in their spending could harm its business, revenue, and financial results.

risks.title: Decline in user engagement
risks.score_rationale: User engagement is critical to the company's success, and a decline in engagement could lead to loss of advertisers and revenue.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a crowded and competitive market, and increased competition could harm its business and revenue.

risks.title: Regulations and laws
risks.score_rationale: Regulations and laws related to data protection and privacy could have a negative impact on the company's business.

risks.title: Advertising dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on advertising to generate revenue, and a reduction in advertising could harm its business.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, including hacker attacks or data breaches, which could harm its business and reputation.

ai_positioning.summary: Pinterest positions AI as a core element of its corporate strategy. AI powers AI-based recommendation systems to deliver relevant and engaging content to users, and plays a central role in creating value for advertisers.
evidence: AI-powered visual search and discovery platform
First party, intent-based signal from user actions on Pinterest helps power the AI based recommendation systems
AI also plays a central role in how we drive value for our advertisers
